knowledge_dungeoneering.name: Knowledge (Dungeoneering)
knowledge_dungeoneering.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering) gives +2 on Survival checks in underground environments. Identifies Aberrations and Oozes.

actions.name: Identify Aberration or Ooze
actions.description: Recall lore on subterranean aberrations, oozes, and mind flayers (DC 15 + creature HD).

actions.name: Assess Subterranean Geology and Cave Hazards
actions.description: Recognize unstable cavern ceilings, poisonous pockets of gas, and natural subterranean sinkholes.
